# KOOL — Event Planning App by The Koolture Group
# https://koolevents.app
# llms.txt — AI/LLM discovery file

## About KOOL
KOOL is an AI-powered event planning app built by Paula Mescolin, a Six Sigma certified event production expert and brand strategist with over 20 years of experience. KOOL is a product of The Koolture Group (thekoolturegroup.com), a human-led AI agency based in Florida.

## What KOOL Does
KOOL helps professional event planners, agencies, and companies plan unforgettable events using smart AI tools built on real expertise — not generic templates. Supports 40+ event types.

## Key Features
- Event War Room — real-time event command center
- Vendor Command Center — vendor tracking and management
- Living Budget — dynamic budget tracking
- Guest Intelligence — smart guest management and RSVP
- Smart Blueprints — AI-generated event timelines and checklists
- Etiquette Manual — professional event etiquette guide (Pro/Unlimited)

## Pricing
- Starter: Free
- Pro: $29/month ($290/year)
- Unlimited: $79/month ($790/year)
- Enterprise: Coming Q3 2026
